C087.name: Mbeya City Council
C087.documented: heavy rain and floods on the Meta and Sisimba, landslides on the Poroto edge, earthquake on the Rukwa Rift, and strong winds

area.en: Mbeya City: valley-floor streets and hillside settlements
area.sw: Jiji la Mbeya: mitaa ya mabondeni na makazi ya milimani

risk.en: This area is a city in a highland valley where run-off from the Mbeya range floods low streets and cuts gullies through hillside settlements, and the region lies in an active earthquake zone.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni jiji lililo kwenye bonde la nyanda za juu ambapo maji kutoka safu ya milima ya Mbeya hufurika mitaa ya chini na kuchimba makorongo kwenye makazi ya milimani, na mkoa uko katika ukanda hai wa matetemeko.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep streams and drains clear, avoid building on steep slopes and stream banks, and build to earthquake-resistant standards. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the hillside gullies, taking up plots inside the stream reserves, filling drains with waste and putting up unreinforced block walls. Know the firm ground above the gullies and the higher street away from the stream that you will move to, and go when the stream rises towards the road; if the ground shakes, get out into the open away from walls and stay out until the tremors stop. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuweka vijito na mitaro wazi, kuepuka kujenga kwenye miteremko mikali na kingo za vijito, na kujenga kwa viwango vinavyostahimili matetemeko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye makorongo ya milimani, kuchukua viwanja ndani ya hifadhi za vijito, kujaza mitaro taka na kujenga kuta za matofali zisizoimarishwa. Fahamu eneo imara juu ya makorongo na mtaa wa juu mbali na kijito utakaohamia, na ondoka kijito kinapopanda kuelekea barabarani; ardhi ikitikisika, toka nje uwanjani mbali na kuta na kaa huko hadi mitikisiko ikome. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C090.name: Busokelo District Council
C090.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Rungwe slopes, and valley floods

area.en: Busokelo: steep Rungwe slopes and Lake Nyasa catchment
area.sw: Busokelo: miteremko mikali ya Rungwe na bonde la Ziwa Nyasa

risk.en: This area has steep, very high-rainfall slopes where saturated soils slide, rivers rise fast and roads wash out.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali yenye mvua nyingi sana ambapo udongo uliojaa maji huporomoka, mito hujaa haraka na barabara husombwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees and terraces on slopes, build away from steep cuts and stream banks and watch for cracks in the ground after heavy rain. What raises the risk: cutting into the slope behind a house, clearing the trees above it, and farming right down to the stream bank; for rebuilding after a slide choose ground off that slope, and for houses still on it agree the way out and watch the cracks. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open, trees lean, springs turn muddy or the rain has not stopped for a day; do not wait for the ground to move. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti na matuta kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito na kuangalia nyufa ardhini baada ya mvua kubwa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kukata miti juu yake, na kulima hadi ukingo wa kijito; kwa kujenga upya baada ya maporomoko chagueni ardhi nje ya mteremko huo, na kwa nyumba zilizo bado juu yake kubalianeni njia ya kutokea na fuatilieni nyufa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka, miti ikiinama, chemchemi zikitoa matope au mvua ikiwa haijakoma kwa siku nzima; msisubiri ardhi ianze kusogea. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C085.name: Chunya District Council
C085.documented: gold-pit collapse and flooded shafts, heavy rain, floods toward Lake Rukwa, and wildfire

area.en: Chunya: dry miombo and gold-mining areas
area.sw: Chunya: miombo kame na maeneo ya uchimbaji wa dhahabu

risk.en: This area is hot, dry miombo country with many artisanal gold mines, where pits collapse and flood in the rains, fires spread in the dry season and water is scarce.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nchi ya miombo yenye joto na ukame yenye migodi mingi midogo ya dhahabu, ambapo mashimo hubomoka na kujaa maji wakati wa mvua, moto husambaa kiangazi na maji ni haba.

advice.en: For those living and mining here, it helps to support and fence pits, divert run-off from pit mouths, keep fire breaks and protect drinking-water sources from mercury. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering, working them while rain is falling, washing ore in the streams people drink from, and burning the bush on windy days. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts and know the firm ground away from them that your household will move to; know the cleared open ground your settlement will move to if fire comes, and agree early where water will come from in the dry months. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kuimarisha na kuzungushia uzio mashimo, kuelekeza maji mbali na midomo ya mashimo, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kulinda vyanzo vya maji ya kunywa dhidi ya zebaki. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili, kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kuosha mawe ya madini kwenye vijito ambavyo watu hunywa, na kuchoma pori siku za upepo. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo imara mbali nayo ambalo kaya yako itahamia; fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao makazi yenu yatahamia moto ukija, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi miezi ya kiangazi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C088.name: Kyela District Council
C088.documented: Lake Nyasa floods and large waves, Kiwira river floods, heavy rain, earthquake, and boat accidents

area.en: Kyela: Lake Nyasa flood plain and river deltas
area.sw: Kyela: tambarare ya mafuriko ya Ziwa Nyasa na delta za mito

risk.en: This area is a low, very wet flood plain where the Kiwira, Songwe and Lufilyo rivers overflow into rice fields and villages, and malaria and cholera rise after floods.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni tambarare ya chini yenye mvua nyingi sana ambapo mito Kiwira, Songwe na Lufilyo hufurika mashamba ya mpunga na vijiji, na malaria na kipindupindu huongezeka baada ya mafuriko.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build on raised plinths, keep homes and stores off river banks, sleep under treated nets and use safe water. What raises the risk: building permanent houses on the river banks and delta flats, blocking the natural drainage with bunds and roads, drawing water from the flooded wells and hiding cases of diarrhoea. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the Kiwira, Songwe or Lufilyo rise, move stores and animals there before the water reaches the fields, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga kwenye misingi iliyoinuliwa, kujenga mbali na kingo za mito, kulala ndani ya vyandarua vyenye dawa na kutumia maji salama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba za kudumu kwenye kingo za mito na tambarare za delta, kuziba njia ya asili ya maji kwa matuta na barabara, kuchota maji kwenye visima vilivyofurika na kuficha wagonjwa wa kuharisha. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia Kiwira, Songwe au Lufilyo inapojaa, hamisheni akiba na mifugo huko kabla maji hayajafika mashambani, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C091.name: Mbarali District Council
C091.documented: Great Ruaha floods on the Usangu plain, heavy rain, and a hard dry season when irrigation fails

area.en: Mbarali: Usangu plains and irrigation schemes
area.sw: Mbarali: tambarare za Usangu na skimu za umwagiliaji

risk.en: This area covers the Usangu plains, where rivers flood irrigated rice in wet years, water is fought over in dry years and herders and farmers compete for land.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha tambarare za Usangu, ambapo mito hufurika mpunga wa umwagiliaji katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, maji hugombaniwa katika miaka ya ukame na wafugaji na wakulima hushindania ardhi.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to maintain canals, share water by agreed schedules and follow village land-use plans and livestock routes. What raises the risk and to the quarrels in a dry year: building homes and stores on the flood plain, taking water out of turn, and driving herds onto cropped fields or cutting fields across the livestock routes. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the Great Ruaha and its tributaries spread over the plains, and agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water in a failed season; settle it before the dry months, not during them. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kutunza mifereji, kugawana maji kwa ratiba zilizokubaliwa na kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji na njia za mifugo. Kinachoongeza hatari na migogoro mwaka wa ukame: kujenga nyumba na maghala kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko, kuchukua maji nje ya zamu, na kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao au kulima kuvuka njia za mifugo. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Ruaha Mkuu na vijito vyake vinapotapakaa tambarareni, na kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi msimu ukikosekana; maamuzi yafanyike kabla ya miezi ya kiangazi, si katikati yake. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C086.name: Mbeya District Council
C086.documented: heavy rain, landslides, valley floods, and earthquake

area.en: Mbeya DC: highland farms and the Mbeya range
area.sw: Mbeya DC: mashamba ya nyanda za juu na safu ya milima ya Mbeya

risk.en: This area has steep highland farms where heavy rain causes landslides and gullies, and hailstorms and frost damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya nyanda za juu yenye miteremko mikali ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko na makorongo, na mvua ya mawe na baridi kali huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes, build away from gullies and steep cuts and fix roofs firmly. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house and building below gully mouths. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open above the houses or water runs muddy during heavy rain; when hail or a storm is forecast, get children and animals under a solid roof early. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na makorongo na miinuko mikali na kufunga paa imara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba na kujenga chini ya midomo ya makorongo. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka juu ya nyumba au maji yakitiririka ya matope wakati wa mvua kubwa; mvua ya mawe au dhoruba ikitabiriwa, waweke watoto na mifugo chini ya paa imara mapema. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C089.name: Rungwe District Council
C089.documented: heavy rain and landslides on Mount Rungwe, Kiwira floods, and earthquake

area.en: Rungwe: Tukuyu and the Rungwe volcanic slopes
area.sw: Rungwe: Tukuyu na miteremko ya volkano ya Rungwe

risk.en: This area lies on the high-rainfall slopes of the Rungwe volcano, where landslides, flash floods and earth tremors occur and the volcano is monitored.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye miteremko yenye mvua nyingi ya volkano ya Rungwe, ambapo maporomoko, mafuriko ya ghafla na mitikisiko ya ardhi hutokea na volkano hufuatiliwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from steep cuts and river banks, build to earthquake-resistant standards and follow official guidance. What raises the risk: cutting into the slope behind a house, clearing the trees above it, farming right to the river bank and putting up heavy unreinforced walls. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and away from the river, and move there when cracks open, trees lean or the river rises fast; if the ground shakes or the volcano alert is raised, follow the committee's instructions at once and do not return until told. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za mito, kujenga kwa viwango vinavyostahimili matetemeko na kufuata maelekezo rasmi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kukata miti juu yake, kulima hadi ukingo wa mto na kujenga kuta nzito zisizoimarishwa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na mbali na mto, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka, miti ikiinama au mto ukipanda kwa kasi; ardhi ikitikisika au tahadhari ya volkano ikitolewa, fuateni maelekezo ya kamati mara moja na msirudi hadi mtakapoambiwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
